name: MicroPyMesh
short_description: MeshCore messenger for the built-in LoRa radio
long_description: MicroPyMesh is a MeshCore messenger for MicroPythonOS devices with a built-in SX1262 LoRa radio, laid out for 480x480 touch screens (developed on the SenseCAP Indicator D1L). Public, hashtag and private channels; encrypted direct messages with delivery acknowledgements; contacts and discovered nodes; repeater and room login, status and trace; routing with typed paths, path hash sizes and region scopes; an offline map from SD card tiles; light and dark themes. Runs in the background to keep receiving while the app is closed. Based on fri3d-meshcore by lucid-void. An independent, community-built client: not affiliated with or endorsed by the MeshCore project. MESHCORE is a trademark of its owner.
